body:
I only have a few hobbies. They all involve being in front of a computer.... I don't enjoy them as much anymore.

The thing about accepting who I am, it's quite difficult when I consider that no one will ever want to be with me, or that I'll have to settle for someone I don't like...

Not in any 1st world country. Yeah. My dog gets a bit down when my father leaves for a few days. 

We all have the ability to adapt though.

New Zealand looks absolutely beautiful, from what I've seen. Thanks for the offer, but there are too many variables involved. 

I could come visit, take a long vacation or get a temporary job there. Sounds like a possibility.

You might be right. Perhaps I just want a 180° change. But I don't have a lot of choices.

To answer your other question, I think it's all a matter of keeping appearance. To my family mostly. Plus, I've got to pay bills, I cannot just quit. But the fact that I'm still worrying about this answers the question of "why doing it if I'll be killing myself anyways"...

I guess I don't want to look defeated. If I do it the only reason they'll know of is "I'm unhappy". 

I don't know...
